QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Claudine's Message
QuestInfo.0: Claudine's done recording her message. Now's the perfect time to talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Claudine's message is for her little sister, #bUlrika#k. You can find her in #bEdelstein#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Claudine's message to #bUlrika#k, who was overjoyed at the news!
